details: Floyd--Warmuth lower bound for general sample compression.
proof: A labeled compression scheme is a general sample compression scheme.  Floyd and Warmuth prove that every general compression scheme for a class of VC dimension $d$ has size at least $\lceil d/5\rceil$.  Hence $\mathrm{LSC}(\mathcal H)\ge (1/5)\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
name: Labeled Sample Compression / VC Dimension
